# Exploratory data analysis

[Overall patterns that motivate the three research questions.]

```{python}
#| label: fig-names-per-year
#| fig-cap: "Distinct names published per year in the state file, by recorded sex. A name counts once per year and sex, whichever states it appears in."
if STATE_PATH.exists():
    import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

    distinct = state.groupby(["year", "sex"], observed=True)["name"].nunique().unstack("sex")
    fig, ax = plt.subplots()
    for sex in ["F", "M"]:
        ax.plot(distinct.index, distinct[sex], color=visualisation.SEX_COLOURS[sex],
                label=visualisation.SEX_LABELS[sex])
    ax.set_xlabel("Year of birth")
    ax.set_ylabel("Distinct names (published)")
    ax.legend()
    plt.show()
else:
    print("data/processed/state.parquet not found: run scripts/build_dataset.py")
```

[Interpretation, remembering that suppression hides names with fewer than 5
births per state and year.]
